notes.title: Threefold Recital Soundtrack is out now！
notes.content:
Thank you all for your continuous support! Today, the Trilateral Tale Original Soundtrack is officially available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486410/_/

The Threefold Recital Soundtrack features 48 original tracks from the game, meticulously crafted by Mi Lu Music and projectlights. Each piece is deeply woven into the game's atmosphere, Lividly portraying the wonders of the Trinity world. The melodies intertwine with the highs and lows of adventure, the clash of emotions, and those unforgettable moments within the story. We hope that when the music plays, it brings back memories of your journey—every little moment, every joy and sorrow shared with the characters.

Additionally, the bundle of Threefold Recital and the soundtrack is now available too! Purchasing them together grants a 10% discount. If you already own the base game, you can get the OST at a lower price through this bundle.

Once again, thank you all!

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Fix:[/h2]

Fixed an issue where the story could not progress if the player investigated the tiger before investigating the chicken during the investigation in the hall before the debate in Chapter 4.
(Players who have already encountered this issue and saved their progress can investigate the karma line of the two chickens again to continue the story.)

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Optimization:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Moved an important explanation about "Bodypaint" in Chapter 3 to a main storyline event that is guaranteed to trigger.
[*] Added a "sparkling" effect to certain main storyline investigation points that are easy to overlook.
[*] Optimized the event trigger for the Plate Puzzle in Chapter 5.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the game's physics detection to reduce the issue of the protagonist falling through the ground.
[*] Fixed various text errors and map display issues.
[*] Fixed an issue where the cursor would briefly appear when moving between rooms.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain settings might not save correctly.
[*] Fixed missing effects when consuming karmarines and adjusted their display in certain story scenes.
[*] Fixed untranslated UI elements in Traditional Chinese, English, and Japanese.
[*] Fixed an issue where illustrations might disappear when navigating the illustration gallery without using a mouse.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 4 where investigating the lobby in a specific sequence before a debate could cause character display errors.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Optimizations:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added automatic scene transitions in several story sections in Chapter 4 when appropriate conditions are met, minimizing unnecessary backtracking during Taiqing's alchemy tasks.
[*] Added a task reminder for the main storyline in Chapter 4 to prevent confusion between main and side quests.
[*] Reworked left joystick control for all UIs, making it more natural and reducing unintentional inputs and accidental touches.
[*] Optimized left joystick control experience for moving the circular cursor (applies to any interface requiring the use of a circular cursor, including severing lines, moving rooms, etc.).
[*] Enlarged the circular cursor in the Move Room interface for better visibility.
[*] Adjusted the performance of a severing-lines scene in the final chapter to avoid misleading player actions.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed some text errors in Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
[*] Fixed incorrect text highlight in Traditional Chinese.
[*] Fixed an issue where character names in the dialogue record might not display correctly in certain resolutions in Traditional Chinese.
[*] Fixed an issue where the last hint might not display fully in certain resolutions in English and Japanese versions.
[*] Fixed a scene display error at the end of Chapter 4.
[*] Fixed an issue during the on-site investigation in Chapter 2, where clues could be recorded prematurely in certain investigative sequences.
[*] Fixed a UI texture error in the final chapter of the Traditional Chinese version.
[*] Fixed an issue in the Art Book appreciation section where keyboard and controller inputs couldn't zoom in on images.
[*] Fixed an issue whereGran Miao didn't appear during a certain story section in Chapter 2.
[*] Fixed an issue where selecting options too quickly in the  Teller Fon and Move Room interface could lead to incorrect choices.
[*] Adjusted the timing for returning Thunder room in Chapter 3 to avoid story logic problems.
[*] Fixed the collision mechanism in the ring-toss mini-game to reduce instances where it gets stuck.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Added 4K resolution option in settings.
[*] Introduced a skip feature for the final multi-room puzzle after a certain number of attempts or amount of time.
[/olist]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Corrected some text errors in various languages.
[*] Fixed display errors in chapter title animations for Traditional Chinese, English, and Japanese.
[*] Resolved the issue where Gran Miao could still be interacted with after disappearing.
[*] Fixed a potential freeze during the Great Buddha challenge.
[*] Adjusted some misleading button prompt icons.
[*] Improved collision detection for traversing paintings, making it more obvious.
[*] Fixed a bug where Taiqing could destroy Generall Tso’s room door.
[*] Replaced the handwritten font for Traditional Chinese, addressing missing character issues.
[*] Corrected the handwritten font used for the final wall hints in English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese.
[*] Fixed the issue where the character would switch incorrectly during subsequent ring game with Taiqing (the first switch works as intended).
[*] Resolved an issue where resetting to default settings would revert resolution and frame rate.
[*] Fixed UI and texture errors in the English language setting.
[/olist]

notes.title: Threefold Recital is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you all for your continued support and interest in Threefold Recital. The game is officially launching today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3084280/

For the first two weeks after release, there's a 10% launch discount. If you're interested in the game, please don't miss this opportunity!

If you love the game, we'd greatly appreciate it if you could leave a recommendation on the Steam page—that's really had for important for early exposure. Also, feel free to recommend it to your friends~

Join the Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/nTtkX2fdCh]https://discord.gg/nTtkX2fdCh[/url]
————————————

Notes on the Launch Version

[list]
[*] For dual-monitor users, the game may not function properly in full-screen mode. To resolve this, set the display scaling of the corresponding monitor to 100% in Windows display settings or temporarily disable the second monitor. Alternatively, you can delete the Config.sav file located at: C:\Users\xxxx\AppData\LocalLow\EverscapeGames\ThreefoldRecital. 

We'll work to fix this issue as soon as possible.
 
[*] The launch version will carry over save data from the previous demo version (which includes the prologue) and unlock any achievements already earned. If you prefer not to carry over save data, you can delete all save files in the folder:
C:\Users\xxxx\AppData\LocalLow\EverscapeGames\ThreefoldRecital in advance.
 
[*] English localization will continue to be refined and improved after the game's release.
[/list]

notes.title: Threefold Recital will launch on January 14, 2025!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Developed by Everscape Games and published by indienova, the narrative-driven adventure game [b]Threefold Recital[/b] is officially set to release on January 14, 2025, and will be priced at $14.99 USD, with a 10% launch discount for the first two weeks!

[previewyoutube=N0MYx0Cb_xo;full][/previewyoutube]

Inspired by folklore and strange tales, Threefold Recital creates a fantastical Eastern world where humans, monsters, and dragons coexist. In this world, the once-prosperous Azure Dragon City has descended into a chaotic era of Taoist magic, mechanical arts, and rediscovered ancient technology. Amid this turmoil, a new darkness quietly brews, setting the stage for an unprecedented crisis.

Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist. We look forward to the day Threefold Recital meets everyone!

notes.title: First Greetings! And Information About the Demo
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for checking our first announcement! We have just finished our trip to the BitSummit in Kyoto. During the event, the first demo of our game went live on Steam. We received a lot of valuable feedback from both on-site and online community players, and we are very grateful to everyone for that!

The first demo is quite short, intended only to show the concept and style of Threefold Recital, and try to gather some feedback. However, as a story-driven game, this demo didn't fully capture the charm of the game. Considering this, we have decided to temporarily take down the demo and focus on developing the next trial version. What we can reveal for now is that the next demo version will include some optimizations and the COMPLETE first chapter of the story, so you can better experience the world of Threefold Recital.

And don't forget to add our game to your wishlist if you like it~

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3084280/_/

Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/f82ERsqENv]https://discord.gg/f82ERsqENv[/url]

See you soon!
